in_scope.instructions:
sos-*.exo.io are the subdomains related to our S3-compatible Object Storage service (called SOS). Have a look at [the SOS product documentation](https://community.exoscale.com/product/storage/object-storage/). These endpoints implement the S3 protocol. 


There is a subdomain for each zone where the service is offered: 

https://sos-ch-gva-2.exo.io
https://sos-ch-dk-2.exo.io
https://sos-de-fra-1.exo.io
https://sos-de-muc-1.exo.io
https://sos-at-vie-1.exo.io
https://sos-at-vie-2.exo.io
https://sos-bg-sof-1.exo.io
https://sos-hr-zag-1.exo.io

Please note that there may be resources owned by customers on these domains. Customers' resources are out of scope.
